meta.title: Another Term
meta.description: Why Bomet should send Sen. Hillary Sigei back to the Senate: his story, his record, and the draft commitments for a second term.

hero.title: Another term for Bomet
hero.lead: A short story in five chapters, and the work still to finish.

mtoto.title: Mtoto wa Bomet
mtoto.subtitle: Child of Bomet
mtoto.body: Ndamichonik Primary. Tenwek High. Then law at the University of Nairobi. A local son who became a lawyer.
mtoto.stat: years from his KCPE (1995) to his law degree (2005)

wakili.title: Wakili
wakili.subtitle: The lawyer
wakili.body: About thirteen years building a legal career, from Katwa & Kemboy Advocates in 2009 to managing partner of SMS Advocates LLP, and a Master of Laws on top. He brought that training to the Senate.
wakili.stat: years at the bar before he entered the Senate

sauti.title: Sauti ya Bomet
sauti.subtitle: The voice of Bomet
sauti.body: Fellow senators chose him to chair the Justice, Legal Affairs and Human Rights Committee in October 2022, and chose him again in February 2025.
sauti.stat: times elected chair of the Senate Justice Committee

kazi.title: Kazi
kazi.subtitle: The work
kazi.body: The Tea (Amendment) Bill for small-scale growers, passed by the Senate. Oversight that put Bomet's county spending under scrutiny. Questions on ECDE milk, water and gender-based violence.
kazi.stat: small-scale tea growers the Tea Bill is written for

iendelee.title: Kazi Iendelee
iendelee.subtitle: The work continues
iendelee.body: The Tea Bill still has to become law. The oversight that began has to be finished. And there is more to do. Here is what is proposed next, and how you can hold it to account.

commitments.title: Commitments for a second term
commitments.lead: Each one says what, why, how and how you can measure it. All are drafts until the Senator approves them.
commitments.draftBanner: DRAFT: these commitments are awaiting the Senator's approval.

why.title: Four reasons, backed by the record
why.lead: Not promises. Things that have already happened, each with a source.

law.title: A lawyer's training, in service of Bomet
law.body: Years of practice before the Senate means he reads a bill, a contract and an audit query the way a lawyer does: closely.

trust.title: Trusted by fellow senators
trust.body: Chosen to lead the Justice Committee in 2022, and chosen again in 2025.

tea.title: Delivers where tea farmers need it
tea.body: He sponsored the Tea (Amendment) Bill and it passed the Senate. Next: the National Assembly.

oversight.title: Holds spending to account
oversight.body: Statements, audit hearings and questions on Bomet's stalled projects, water company and ECDE milk, all on the public record.

letter.title: A letter from the Senator
letter.draft: DRAFT: for the Senator to edit and sign
letter.p1: I grew up in this county. I know what a good tea season means for a household, what a classroom needs, and what it costs when promised projects stand unfinished.
letter.p2: In the Senate I have tried to do three things: sponsor laws that put farmers first, ask hard questions about how public money is spent, and defend the institutions that keep us safe and free.
letter.p3: There is unfinished work. I would be honoured to finish it with you.

cta.title: Walk with Bomet, 10 August 2027
cta.body: Make your pledge and bring one person with you.
